recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-17755; any future work on the broader Goal status model should be handled under the separate status-split issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-17755 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for FHIR-core Goal, applied for R5, asking to add Goal.continuous as a 0..1 boolean that indicates whether ongoing activity is needed after meeting the goal objective.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git commit 0c215305ab3db65b58cc5896d0ed7257ba1d5479 (GF#17755 Add Goal.continuous), which added the Goal.continuous spreadsheet row and added continuous=true to the Goal example. The later new-build-core source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that element into source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current authoritative Goal StructureDefinition includes Goal.continuous with cardinality 0..1, boolean type, the requested definition, rationale, and yellow-fever/HbA1c examples. The same element remains in the current Goal example. FHIR-17756 is related background on splitting Goal status into lifecycle and achievement status, but it is broader than the continuous-element request.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already implements the requested element and preserves the Jira-approved semantics.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-17755 comments cite this as a related Goal status/progress split, but it is a broader Goal status-model issue and was not needed to decide the continuous-element reconciliation.
